name: Modular Hull Socket Item
desc: Something that can be installed in a Modular Hull Socket on a ship's skill tree.

name: Hull Upgrade Item
desc: Unique hull upgrade that grants one Hull Framework point to a ship of one hull size.

name: Nanite Feedstock
desc: Components recovered by disassembling hull items you no longer need.

name: Augmentation Swarm
desc: Adds one more rolled effect to a domain subroutine, up to four. A common subroutine that gains its third effect becomes rare.

name: Tuning Swarm
desc: Rerolls the values of every effect on a hull item within its usual range.

name: Metamorph Swarm
desc: Rewrites a unique hull item into a different unique hull item.

name: Fundamental Swarm
desc: Rerolls the values of a hull item's implicit effects within their usual range.

name: Reshaping Swarm
desc: Removes a random effect from a hull item and rolls a new one in its place. Fixed effects are never removed.

name: Immutable Swarm
desc: Fixes one random effect on a hull item with at least two effects. A fixed effect can't be removed or rerolled, and each hull item can only have one.

name: Replicator Nanoseed
desc: Makes a mirrored copy of a hull item. Mirrored items can't be modified or copied again. Replication Kernels can't be synthesised.

name: Corrupted Swarm
desc: Corrupts a hull item with an unpredictable result. Corrupted items can't be modified any further.

name: Prefix Inhibitor
desc: Turned on at the Hull Item Modification workbench. The next Recalibration Substitution or Fixation leaves every existing prefix alone. Wards can only be found.

name: Suffix Inhibitor
desc: Turned on at the Hull Item Modification workbench. The next Recalibration Substitution or Fixation leaves every existing suffix alone. Wards can only be found.
